summary: Verified root-cause fix for GET /api/sessions payload bloat (was returning up to 1000 sessions with base64 signatures ~1.57GB for admin, causing origin exhaustion/502s). Backend: 7/7 executed pytest tests passed (2 correctly skipped for non-existent backend routes; blind/proficiency summaries are frontend-only routes). Confirmed lightweight sessions response (<1MB, no signature/signaturePreview inside ballots, no verificationSignature), fast response, ballot submit still completes sessions correctly (session_status var rename OK), admin dashboards + daily/blind/proficiency summary routes load with expected data, and 15-iteration stability loop of /api/sessions + /api/admin/sessions/all + /api/admin/daily-summary/2026-06-18 returned zero non-200 responses. Frontend: login flows no longer trigger GET /api/sessions (only lightweight GET /api/ health ping), 'Connected' badge shows on panelist dashboard, admin dashboard opens summary routes in new window and each renders with correct totals (24 regular for 2026-06-18, 10 blind for 2026-06-18, 10 SPPS for 2026-06-26 with verification signatures visible).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~575 lines, still within limits but split into modules (auth, sessions, admin, verifications) would help maintainability.
GET /api/admin/sessions/all still uses to_list(1000); consider pagination for future scale.
submit_ballot has no auth dependency (only session_code required) — anyone with a session code can post ballots; consider adding get_current_user dependency.
get_daily_summary uses regex on stringified dates for date filtering; storing dates as native datetime + $gte/$lt would be more efficient and index-friendly.
clear_sessions (DELETE /api/admin/sessions) has no confirmation token; risk of accidental full wipe — consider requiring an explicit query flag.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 new completed regular session via testpanelist (session code 524B4742) as part of ballot regression test; expected and previously approved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: GET /api/sessions is now capped at 200 items with base64 signatures excluded (~256KB admin response). Frontend login does GET /api/ (root health) instead of /api/sessions. Admin daily/blind/proficiency summary tabs in AdminDashboard use window.open() to /daily-summary/{date}, /blind-test-summary/{date}, /proficiency-test-summary/{date} routes — they do NOT switch active tab in dashboard. When automating those, either intercept popup or navigate directly to the route after login. Radix/shadcn Tabs are not used for those; they are custom Button-based tabs. verify-summary endpoint was not tested (skipped per instructions — all target dates already verified).
rca of the issue: Prior GET /api/sessions returned up to 1000 sessions in full, including per-ballot base64 signature images and per-session verificationSignature (~1.5GB payload for admin). Response inflated origin memory + bandwidth, causing Cloudflare 502s on the preview URL and 'Uncaught runtime errors' on the SPA. Fix (server.py line ~334): (1) MongoDB projection excludes ballots.signature, ballots.signaturePreview, verificationSignature; (2) to_list capped at 200; (3) frontend App.js checkConnection now hits GET /api/ (root) as a lightweight health check; (4) ErrorBoundary + axios retry interceptor cover transient 502/503/504 network blips. Verified end-to-end.
